verdict.rationale: Trivy explicitly documents built-in misconfiguration checks for Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, CloudFormation and more, and community feedback corroborates it as a solid, easy-to-automate scanner used in CI/CD. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation specifically of IaC misconfiguration scanning (community quotes focus mostly on vuln/secret scanning) and no deep dive on custom policy authoring.
